lines.zh: 我每走一步，地面都发绿光
lines.en: Each step I take, the ground glows green.

lines.zh: 我的背上有几道裂口，光从里漏
lines.en: Cracks in my back leak light.

lines.zh: 森林在我靠近时安静下来
lines.en: The forest goes quiet as I near.

lines.zh: 我踩断一棵小树，没有声音
lines.en: I crush a sapling without a sound.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖过草地，草卷了起来
lines.en: My tail drags the grass into curls.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可我不敢快
lines.en: I walk slowly; I dare not go faster.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气带着热
lines.en: The air I breathe out carries heat.

lines.zh: 树皮上有我蹭过的痕迹
lines.en: There are marks where I brushed the bark.

lines.zh: 我身上有股金属烧过的味道
lines.en: I smell of scorched metal.

lines.zh: 我走到哪儿，哪儿就暗一点
lines.en: Where I walk, the light dims a little.

lines.zh: 我低头避过一根横枝
lines.en: I duck under a low branch.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩进泥里，泥冒烟
lines.en: My foot sinks in mud and the mud steams.

lines.zh: 我从两棵树中间挤过去
lines.en: I squeeze between two trees.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上留下焦印
lines.en: My claws leave scorch prints.

lines.zh: 我站着，背上一直有光在动
lines.en: I stand, and light moves along my back.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，一点火星掉在土上
lines.en: I open my mouth and a spark drops to the soil.

lines.zh: 附近的虫都不叫了
lines.en: The insects near me have gone silent.

lines.zh: 我慢慢呼吸，空气发热
lines.en: I breathe slowly and the air warms.

lines.zh: 我的脚下草已经黄了
lines.en: The grass beneath me has yellowed.

lines.zh: 我抬起爪子看了看
lines.en: I lift a claw and look at it.

lines.zh: 光从我的牙缝里出来
lines.en: Light escapes between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我像一座会喘的炉子
lines.en: I am like a furnace that breathes.

lines.zh: 林子里的鸟绕开我这片
lines.en: The birds go around my patch of wood.

lines.zh: 我低头看着地上自己的光
lines.en: I lower my head to my own glow on the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬头，眼里的光晃了晃
lines.en: I lift my head and the light in my eyes shifts.

lines.zh: 一滴绿色的东西从我的牙上落下
lines.en: A green drop falls from my teeth.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴在地上盘起来
lines.en: I coil my tail on the ground.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，光暗了又亮
lines.en: I blink slowly; the glow dims and returns.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬头，眼睛亮着
lines.en: I raise my head slowly, my eyes lit.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，热不热
lines.en: You stand very close; is it hot?

lines.zh: 我的胸口起伏，光跟着明暗
lines.en: My chest rises and the light pulses.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你小得像块石子。
lines.en: I look down and you're as small as a pebble.

lines.zh: 我的手比你整个人还大
lines.en: My hand is bigger than all of you.

lines.zh: 我不需要走近
lines.en: I do not need to come closer.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸把你的头发吹起
lines.en: My breath lifts your hair.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我还在原处
lines.en: You move back two steps; I have not moved.

lines.zh: 这片林子里我最大
lines.en: I am the largest thing in this wood.

lines.zh: 我低下脖子，光凑到你面前
lines.en: I lower my neck and bring the light to you.

lines.zh: 我的牙比你的手臂长
lines.en: My teeth are longer than your arm.

lines.zh: 你在我脚下像块石头
lines.en: You look like a stone at my feet.

lines.zh: 我挪动一只爪子，土翻了
lines.en: I shift one claw and the soil turns.

lines.zh: 我吸气，周围的空气往里走
lines.en: I inhale and the air moves inward.

lines.zh: 我背上的光暗了一下
lines.en: The light on my back dims.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，地都沉了
lines.en: I give half a step and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 我发出一声很低的声音
lines.en: I make a very low sound.

lines.zh: 我的裂口里漏出更多光
lines.en: More light leaks from my cracks.

lines.zh: 我低下头，喘得更重
lines.en: I lower my head and breathe heavier.

lines.zh: 我背上的光暗了一片
lines.en: A patch of light on my back has dimmed.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，焦土陷了
lines.en: I step back and the scorched earth gives way.

lines.zh: 我低下头，喘得像风箱
lines.en: I lower my head, breathing like a bellows.

lines.zh: 我的裂口里冒出一股烟
lines.en: Smoke comes from one of my cracks.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身体撑起来
lines.en: I slowly push myself upright.

lines.zh: 那点吃食，还不够我烤热一株树。
lines.en: That morsel wouldn't even warm a single tree for me.

lines.zh: 我吃的东西你看不见
lines.en: What I eat, you cannot see.

lines.zh: 不过这味道不错
lines.en: Still, the smell is not bad.

lines.zh: 你举得太近了，会烫
lines.en: You hold it too near; it will scorch.

lines.zh: 放在地上，退开
lines.en: Set it down and step back.

lines.zh: 我低头，鼻息把土吹起
lines.en: I lower my head and my breath lifts the soil.

lines.zh: 我低头嗅了嗅，地上一层焦
lines.en: I sniff; the ground gets a scorched layer.

lines.zh: 这东西被我烤热了
lines.en: The thing has been heated by my presence.

lines.zh: 你把它扔过来，我接住
lines.en: Throw it over and I will catch it.

lines.zh: 我咬了一下，它没了
lines.en: I bite once, and it is gone.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，被烫到
lines.en: You strike me and recoil from the heat.

lines.zh: 我的腿一挪，你就退了
lines.en: One shift of my leg and you give ground.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，草被压平一片
lines.en: We collide and a patch of grass is flattened.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一扫，你脚边的草全焦了。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail scorches the grass at your feet.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞上热石头
lines.en: You hit me as if hitting hot stone.

lines.zh: 相撞的地方有一点焦味
lines.en: There is a scorched smell where we met.

lines.zh: 你的重量在我这儿不算什么
lines.en: Your weight is nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我一低头，把你顶开
lines.en: I lower my head and push you aside.

lines.zh: 草在我们脚下冒出烟
lines.en: The grass smokes under our feet.

lines.zh: 我的前腿一撑，地面落了一块
lines.en: My foreleg braces and the ground drops.

lines.zh: 她比我背上的光更亮
lines.en: The light on her back is brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们站在一起，周围的草都黄了
lines.en: We stand together and the grass around us yellows.

lines.zh: 她替我蹭了蹭背上的裂
lines.en: She rubs the crack on my back.

lines.zh: 我们不说太多，说话要费热
lines.en: We do not talk much; words cost heat.

lines.zh: 我们的影子把这片林子盖住
lines.en: Our shadows cover this patch of woods.

lines.zh: 她的呼吸把周围的树烘干
lines.en: Her breath dries the trees around us.

lines.zh: 我们并肩走，地面一起响
lines.en: We walk abreast and the ground answers.

lines.zh: 她身上的光是白的，我是绿的
lines.en: Her light is white; mine is green.

lines.zh: 她用尾巴碰了碰我的尾巴
lines.en: She touches her tail to mine.

lines.zh: 这一片林子够我们两个
lines.en: This patch of wood will hold us both.

lines.zh: 我低头，嘴比手好用
lines.en: I lower my head; my mouth works better than hands.

lines.zh: 一块木头在我嘴里冒烟
lines.en: A piece of wood smokes in my jaws.

lines.zh: 我把它拖到一边
lines.en: I drag it aside.

lines.zh: 我捡起一棵断树，很轻
lines.en: I lift a broken tree; it is light to me.

lines.zh: 地上的东西我大多放回去
lines.en: I put most of what I find back down.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起半截树干
lines.en: I take up half a trunk in my jaws.

lines.zh: 它在我嘴里变黑
lines.en: It blackens in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把它丢到一边，地上留个坑
lines.en: I drop it; a pit is left behind.

lines.zh: 我蹲下，前腿把土压塌
lines.en: I crouch and my forelegs crush the soil.

lines.zh: 我把它埋了，用爪子扒土
lines.en: I bury it, clawing the dirt.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛亮了起来
lines.en: My eyes have brightened.

lines.zh: 我脚下的土开始裂
lines.en: The soil cracks beneath me.

lines.zh: 你在我视线正中间
lines.en: You are dead centre in my sight.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，树影退开
lines.en: I raise my head and the shadows withdraw.

lines.zh: 这片地禁不起我动手
lines.en: This ground cannot take my blows.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向你，地面在响
lines.en: I turn toward you and the ground answers.

lines.zh: 我的牙间有光
lines.en: There is light between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我脚下的草瞬间干了
lines.en: The grass at my feet dries at once.

lines.zh: 你在我正前方，太近了
lines.en: You are dead ahead, too close.

lines.zh: 我抬起爪子，地上的草先焦了。
lines.en: I lift a claw and the grass scorches first.

lines.zh: 我呼气，热浪到了你那边
lines.en: I exhale and the heat reaches you.

lines.zh: 最强的那只，居然没撞倒你。
lines.en: The strongest one here didn't knock you down.

lines.zh: 我每落一脚，地就陷下去一块。
lines.en: Every step I take sinks the ground a little more.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪儿，草就黄到哪儿
lines.en: Wherever you run, the grass yellows after me.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸把落叶吹散
lines.en: My breath scatters the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 你不该在这片林子里绕圈
lines.en: You should not circle in these woods.

lines.zh: 我的光在地上拖出一道痕
lines.en: My glow drags a line across the ground.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把地踩出坑
lines.en: I take step by step, pitting the ground.

lines.zh: 我背上的光一直朝着你
lines.en: The light on my back stays toward you.

lines.zh: 树在我经过时弯了
lines.en: Trees bend as I pass.

lines.zh: 你不该往河边跑
lines.en: You should not run for the river.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让你的视线发抖
lines.en: My breath makes your sight waver.

lines.zh: 我抬起尾巴扫断一丛灌木
lines.en: I raise my tail and break the brush.

lines.zh: 我离你很近，地越来越热
lines.en: I am close, and the ground grows hot.

lines.zh: 我一爪拍下，土被烧焦
lines.en: My claw lands and the soil scorches.

lines.zh: 我的头撞过去，很重
lines.en: My head drives into you, heavy.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴横扫，树断了
lines.en: My tail sweeps and a tree snaps.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，热浪扑过去
lines.en: I open my mouth and a wave of heat comes out.

lines.zh: 我一爪砸下，土成了焦块
lines.en: My claw lands and the soil turns to clinker.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫断了三棵树
lines.en: My tail breaks three trees.

lines.zh: 我的头撞在你身上
lines.en: My head drives into you.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，白光过去
lines.en: I open my mouth and white light goes out.

lines.zh: 我的爪子擦过你身边
lines.en: My claw passes close beside you.

lines.zh: 你退开时，鞋底冒烟
lines.en: Smoke rises from your soles as you retreat.

lines.zh: 林子深处亮起一团绿光
lines.en: A green light kindles deep in the wood.

lines.zh: 我踏出树影，草开始黄
lines.en: I step out of the shadows and the grass yellows.

lines.zh: 我先呼出一口气，热的
lines.en: I breathe out first, and it is hot.

lines.zh: 树上的鸟全飞走了
lines.en: Every bird in the trees has fled.

lines.zh: 我站起来，树只到我膝盖。
lines.en: I rise, and the trees reach only my knees.

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下轻轻响
lines.en: The ground murmurs under me.

lines.zh: 我先到了，光后到
lines.en: I arrive first; the light follows.

lines.zh: 我踏进这片林子，草黄了一圈
lines.en: I enter the wood and the grass yellows in a ring.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，树上的叶子卷了
lines.en: I raise my head and the leaves curl.

lines.zh: 我呼出的第一口气是热的
lines.en: My first breath out is hot.

lines.zh: 地面裂了一道，从我脚下
lines.en: A crack runs from beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，看清四周
lines.en: I turn slowly to read the ground.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧，我一点不怕
lines.en: Fire burns on me and I do not mind at all.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，压断一片树
lines.en: I roll down the slope, breaking trees.

lines.zh: 水碰到我就冒白气
lines.en: Water meets me and turns to white steam.

lines.zh: 爆风推了我一下，我晃了晃
lines.en: The blast shoves me and I sway.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的皮里，化了
lines.en: Something lodges in my hide and melts.

lines.zh: 那股力量在我体内乱撞，很难受
lines.en: That force batters inside me; it hurts.

lines.zh: 我身上的火小了，我饿了
lines.en: My fire is low; I am hungry.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，我的光更亮了
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and my glow brightens.

lines.zh: 脚下的土没了，我一路朝下
lines.en: No soil below; I fall and fall.
